title: Work at Constant Temp
description: Essential Criteria: The work done during the isothermal expansion must be correctly calculated as W = RT_0 ln 2.

title: Heat at Constant Temp
description: Essential Criteria: The heat absorbed during the isothermal process must equal the work done, Q = RT_0 ln 2.

title: Work at Constant Pressure
description: Essential Criteria: The work done during the isobaric expansion must be correctly calculated as W = RT_0.

title: Heat at Constant Pressure
description: Essential Criteria: The heat absorbed during the isobaric process must be calculated as Q = (5/2)RT_0.

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Important Criteria: The change in internal energy must be correctly derived as ΔU = (3/2)RT_0.

title: Logarithm Mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for errors in calculating the logarithmic term in the isothermal work.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
